message: As we think about preparedness, it’s a great reminder that gathering supplies can be turned into a cozy little project! 🏡 We can create our own survival kits while enjoying some time together—maybe even with a warm drink in hand. It’s not just about what we pack, but how we make the process engaging and fun. Let’s brainstorm what’s essential for our kits and share some ideas! What’s one item you think is a must-have in a preparedness kit?
